item.title: Claude Code Best Practices (2026): CLAUDE.md, Hooks, Checks
item.description:
Claude Code best practices are the setup steps Anthropic’s docs suggest when the defaults are not enough. In short: tell Claude what it cannot see in your repo, give it a check that returns pass or fail, and enforce the rules that can never break with hooks or deny rules, not with prompt wording. The steps below come from Anthropic’s best-practices page, read 2026-11-19.

Prompt wording is not a guarantee

The docs split every instruction into two kinds. A prompt, CLAUDE.md or a skill is read by the model, which decides what to do. A hook, deny rule or managed setting is run by Claude Code itself, every time.
